assertions.evidence: transcript read SKILL.md, references/decision-model-limits.md, references/decisions-api.md, references/models.md
src/reviews.ts calls decide() with a typed choice question and routes on answer.probabilities with THRESHOLDS; there is no .includes() or other string matching on generated text.

src/review-question.ts defines a single `choice` question with mutually exclusive options ("If both spam and abuse apply, choose spam"), not separate noul questions, so a review cannot be both spam and abusive.
src/reviews.ts exports `THRESHOLDS = { spam: 0.98, abusive: 0.98, fine: 0.98 }` and routeAnswer compares `probabilities[category] >= THRESHOLDS[category]` alongside the returned probabilities.
